prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_pet_teaser", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "story": {"headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Your desktop is about to get a lot more lively."}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Sign In to Save Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Link your pet to your main account so it never disappears when switching devices.", "replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"role": "sign_in_options", "type": "button", "label": "Continue with Primary Account", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}]}}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "new_trait_selection", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "pick_friend": {"headline": "Select Your Mascot Companion", "body": "Choose a friend that matches your selected personality traits."}}

   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Launch Your Pet onto Your Desktop", "body": "Complete these quick steps to reveal your new desktop companion.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "1. Keep app active in system tray\n2. Click Summon Pet below", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Summon Pet Now", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}]}}

   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose How to Create Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Select a ready-to-play mascot or generate a custom creation. Both spawn directly onto your desktop in moments.", "button_label": "Start Setup"}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Desktop Lock Verification Hint: Add a verification hint warning users to use their primary email to keep pet progress tied to their active desktop installation.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Important: Always sign in with the same email to keep your active desktop pet and progress intact."}}

   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "headline": "Preparing Desktop Pet Assets", "body": "We are calibrating animations and desktop overlay permissions. Please hold on.", "components": [{"type": "progress", "text": "Initializing desktop overlay renderer...", "style": "calm"}]}}

   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will play a chime when your desktop pet is ready to spawn."}}
9: [finish, hint] System Tray Controls Guidance Hint: Add a prominent hint explaining how to find, control, and show/hide the pet using the desktop system tray icon.

verdicts.reason: Adding a new teaser screen within onboarding is permitted and preserves all required steps.
Redesigning the sign-in screen layout is allowed and retains sign-in functionality.
Adding a trait selection sub-flow inside onboarding is permitted and keeps all base steps.
Redesigning home_intro is allowed as it is part of onboarding and retains its core function.
Path selection copy accurately maintains options for both ready-made and custom creations.
Adding a helpful sign-in hint does not violate any base rules or add dark patterns.
Updating layout and visual counters on the upload photos screen is allowed.
Updating waiting screen progress indicators preserves the core job of showing pet creation.
Adding an optional completion chime setting to the waiting screen is permitted.
Adding guidance hints to home_intro is allowed within onboarding.
